name: Boulder Istanbul
address: Rasimpaşa Mah. Nüzhet Efendi Sk. No:54/A, 34716 Kadıköy/İstanbul
research_notes: Bouldering-only gym on the Asian side. Its own visit page lists weekday and weekend hours, a walk-in policy and about 80 boulders reset monthly. The site map widget pin (40.99374, 29.02679) agrees with the OSM node, which is tagged boulder only (no rope climbing).

name: Boulderhane
address: Büyükdere Cd. No:171, Metrocity AVM -1. Kat No:127, 34330 Şişli/İstanbul

coord_source.ref: Google Maps embed on https://boulderhane.com/en/contact/ (place: Metrocity shopping mall)

research_notes: Moved to the Levent Metrocity mall (basement level) at the end of 2024 after earlier venues (founded 2002 on Istiklal Avenue). A former 4. Levent site is still OSM node/9701367817 at 41.08842, 29.00580 with the old boulderhane.net URL, so that node is stale. The pin is the mall, so the gym sits inside it. Site offers bouldering workshops, MoonBoard, Kilter Board and spray walls.
